review_kind: Phase 0 contract/threat matrix for ADR-0148 (corrected replacement for the stopped five-Major draft)

sources.unreachable: C:\Users\russe\f3-f5b-captured-replay-20260917 -- prior draft and its five-Major verdict; Windows worktree not reachable from this Linux container

actors.roster_bootstrap_authority: Issues RosterBootstrapAuthorization.v1 plus one-use G1 security-owner and G2 data-owner grants; disjoint key table _SYNTHETIC_ROSTER_BOOTSTRAP_KEYS (trust.py:5890).
actors.dataset_capture_broker: Issues DatasetCaptureAuthorization.v2 plus its own one-use G1+G2 grants; disjoint key table _SYNTHETIC_GRANT_PUBLIC_KEYS (trust.py:5635). The ONLY actor that performs a source provider/filesystem/network read.
actors.lifecycle_authority: Owns PRODUCED->SEALED->PUBLISHED->CAPTURED->CONSUMED, session kinds, port derivation, receipt issuance, CapturedBindings minting and interning, and the new derivation-hop and replay-execution entries.
actors.data_producer_hop: Hop 1. Consumer of raw_event_dataset + source_roster; issuer of the data root. Holds no path, provider, network, reopen, seek or ambient handle.
actors.manifest_producer_hop: Hop 2. Consumer of the published data root; issuer of the manifest root.
actors.replay_run: Hop 3. Two-port V2 consumer; executes only through the broker entry.
actors.f5b_forecast_consumer: Child adapter consuming exactly one V2-authorized captured input.
actors.hostile: Code with full interpreter control inside the test process. Mutable Python internals are NOT treated as an external security boundary (implementation-workflow.md step 4); the claim is the interning/opaque-handle boundary, not OS isolation.

authority.roster_chronology: G1 AND G2 roster-bootstrap grants required; G2 alone refuses BEFORE member, data or capture access. Roster is PUBLISHED, never CAPTURED, before any consumer document exists.
authority.dataset_chronology: DatasetCaptureAuthorization.v2 pins source_roster_root_sha256 + source_roster_publication_receipt_sha256 + source_roster_policy_sha256 (already-required keys, trust.py:5646-5648), so it cannot be issued before the roster published. Ordering is by construction, not by a skippable check.
authority.disjointness: Neither grant family's closed key set or schema literal can satisfy the other. Cross-substitution refuses on the key set before any effect.

invariants.invariant: A derived root's root_ref and stream_id are pure functions of the canonical derivation intent; the hop never names its own root.
input_families: root_ref colliding with an existing stream
derivation intent not equal to ports actually consumed
invariants.forbidden_effect: a second root for the same intent; a stream whose id the caller chose

invariants.invariant: The consumer binding releases only after the derived root's PUBLISHED receipt is durably appended.
input_families: two concurrent hops with the same intent
invariants.expected: no stream / uncapturable PRODUCED or SEALED head requiring re-run / idempotent recovery of the same PUBLISHED stream / loser refuses on existing head
invariants.forbidden_effect: a released binding over an unpublished root; two PUBLISHED roots for one intent

invariants.invariant: ReplayRun.run refuses identically after this change; only the broker entry executes.
invariants.expected: unchanged RuntimeError text on the ordinary paths; intern-check refusal on every forged bindings; success only on a broker-minted V2 bindings
invariants.forbidden_effect: any execution reachable without a broker-minted bindings; any weakening of the existing refusal

invariants.invariant: Ranks derive only from the verified pre-document roster policy over the complete authorized source universe.
input_families: event whose source_id is not in the roster
invariants.expected: zero-event source keeps its rank; every other family refuses before envelope bytes
invariants.forbidden_effect: any policy derived from the resulting tape

invariants.invariant: Every event-envelope/v2 field on the F3 path is projected from authorized captured bytes; no caller supplies envelope metadata.
input_families: v1 member offered to a v2 authorization
v2 member offered to a v1 authorization
invariants.expected: refuse on the schema literal or the closed key set; prior_envelope_sha256 is hop-derived and is not a member field
invariants.forbidden_effect: an unauthorized envelope field reaching a tape

invariants.invariant: The three-hop chronology is publish -> freeze -> port -> CAPTURED -> session -> CONSUME, per hop, with no self-receipt or cycle.
input_families: manifest recording its own root or receipt
invariants.expected: each refuses before the stream, planner or root exists; the exact valid order succeeds
invariants.forbidden_effect: a manifest naming its own root/receipt; a shared run identity across producer and consumer

invariants.invariant: ReplayRun consumes an exact sorted two-port set; the manifest's inner bytes must agree with the data entry on every named field.
input_families: mismatched root, PUBLISHED members, policy, envelope count, ordered digest list, recomputed tape_digest
inner data_captured_receipt naming the replay port instead of the prior hop-2 port
invariants.expected: exact-set cardinality checked before any port object is built; every mismatch refuses before the tape capability is issued
invariants.forbidden_effect: a partially minted bindings; a tape issued on a disagreeing pair

invariants.invariant: V1 CapturedBindings behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged; V2 adds exact-set multiport with per-input one-shot require.
input_families: V1 second require of the same input
V2 require of each input once
V2 second require of one input
V2 require of an undeclared name
invariants.expected: V1 unchanged messages; V2 consuming one input leaves the other reachable and neither twice
invariants.forbidden_effect: any V1 message or cardinality change

invariants.invariant: The forecast consumer accepts only the exact F5a V2 verified set, injected non-serializably at the declared input.
invariants.forbidden_effect: an ambient path or later reconstruction replacing trusted captured input

invariants.invariant: Ordering is availability, derived source rank, source sequence, correction position, payload digest, event ID, and is stable across restart.
invariants.expected: one stable canonical order; restart reproduces the identical terminal identity
invariants.forbidden_effect: an order depending on input presentation

compatibility.check: Re-run the P7 focused suites (test_bundles/test_capture_lifecycle/test_verifier) unchanged; any diff in their results is a Major.

non_goals: no E1, C0, A or B lane
no whole-F3 or whole-F5b closure claim from this ADR alone
open_risks: ADR-0147's disclosed limit is inherited verbatim: POSIX flock release-on-crash is documented, not proven by code, so F3-I02's cross-process claim is same-machine/same-filesystem only.
The prior draft's five Majors are taken as stated in the task; the draft text itself was unreachable, so findings beyond the five are not addressed.
next_gate: One fresh independent Sonnet Phase 0 skeptic, then owner ADR approval. This matrix grants no RED authorization.
